data.description:
Prerequisite: Strength 13 or higher

You've developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling. You gain the following benefits:

- You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling.

- You can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, you and the creature are both restrained until the grapple ends.

Your reflexes are honed against ambush. You gain a +5 bonus to initiative rolls. While you are conscious, you cannot be surprised, and creatures hidden from you gain no advantage on attack rolls against you for being unseen.

You train your body for climbing, jumping, and recovery. Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Rising from prone costs you only 5 feet of movement, climbing costs no extra movement, and you need only 5 feet of movement before a running long or high jump.

You are a skilled performer and impersonator. Increase your Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20. You have advantage on Deception and Performance checks made to pass yourself off as another person, and you can convincingly mimic the speech and mannerisms of others.

You rush across the battlefield to strike hard. When you take the Dash action on your turn, you can make one melee weapon attack or a shove attempt as a bonus action. If you moved at least 10 feet in a straight line before this bonus attack, you deal an extra 5 damage on a hit.

You master rapid crossbow fire at any range. You ignore the loading quality of crossbows, and being within 5 feet of a hostile creature imposes no disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls. When you attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to fire a loaded hand crossbow you hold.

Prerequisite: Dexterity 13 or higher. Your agile parries turn aside blades. While wielding a finesse weapon, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your Armor Class against one melee attack that would hit you.

You fight fluidly with a weapon in each hand. You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class while wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand. You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons at once, and you can engage in two-weapon fighting even when neither weapon has the light property.

You have a sixth sense for dungeons and their perils. You have advantage on checks to find hidden doors and traps, and advantage on saving throws made to avoid or resist traps. You resist damage dealt by traps, and traveling at a fast pace imposes no penalty on your stealth checks.

Your body recovers with remarkable hardiness. Increase your Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you spend Hit Dice to regain hit points, each die restores no fewer hit points than twice your Constitution modifier, regardless of the roll.

Prerequisite: the ability to cast at least one spell. Choose one of acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder when you take this feat. Spells you cast of the chosen type ignore resistance to that damage, and any damage die that rolls a 1 is treated as a 2.

On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a heavy melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one additional melee attack as a bonus action. Before you attack with a heavy melee weapon you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll, and gain +10 to the damage roll if the attack hits.

When you use a healer's kit to stabilize a dying creature, that creature also regains 1 hit point. As an action, you can expend one use of a healer's kit to restore 1d6 + 4 hit points plus additional hit points equal to the target's maximum number of Hit Dice, and a given creature can only benefit from this healing once per rest.
Prerequisite: proficiency with medium armor. Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

Prerequisite: proficiency with heavy armor. Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. While you are wearing heavy armor, nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt to you is reduced by 3.

Prerequisite: Charisma 13 or higher. You can spend 10 minutes addressing up to six friendly creatures that can see, hear, and understand you to hearten them. Each chosen creature gains temporary hit points equal to your level plus your Charisma modifier, provided it is not already protected by such resolve.

Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You always know which way is north and how many hours remain before the next sunrise or sunset. You can accurately recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.
Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with light armor and with shields.

Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn three languages of your choice. You can create written ciphers that others can only decode with magic or by succeeding on an Intelligence check against a Difficulty Class based on your Intelligence.

You have 3 luck points, which you regain when you finish a long rest. When you make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can spend one point to roll an extra d20 and choose which result to use, and you can also spend one point to force an attack roll made against you to be rolled again with the attacker using either result.

When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it. Creatures concentrating on spells as a result of damage you deal have disadvantage on the saving throw to maintain focus, and you have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by a creature within 5 feet of you.

You dabble in the magic of one spellcasting class of your choice. You learn two cantrips plus one 1st-level spell from that class's list, using that class's spellcasting ability for them. You can cast the 1st-level spell once without a slot, regaining that use after a long rest.

You gain training in a pair of combat maneuvers drawn from the Battle Master options. You also gain a single d6 superiority die, spent to fuel those maneuvers and recovered after a short or long rest. If you later gain more superiority dice, this die improves along with them.

Prerequisite: proficiency with medium armor. Wearing medium armor no longer gives you disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. You may also add up to +3 of your Dexterity modifier to Armor Class while wearing medium armor instead of the normal +2 cap.

Your base walking speed rises by 10 feet. Dashing over one turn lets you move across difficult terrain without extra cost for that turn. When you make a melee attack against a creature, that creature cannot make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn, whether the attack hits or not.
Prerequisite: proficiency with light armor. You increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with medium armor and with shields.

While riding, you have advantage on melee attack rolls against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount. You can force an attack aimed at your mount to target you instead. Your mount also gains advantage on Dexterity saving throws, taking no damage on a success and half damage on a failure when it would take half on a success.

You increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You can read the lips of a creature speaking a language you know. Your passive Wisdom (Perception) and passive Intelligence (Investigation) scores each increase by 5.

While wielding a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can use a bonus action to strike with the weapon's opposite end for d4 bludgeoning damage plus your ability modifier. Creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter your reach with such a weapon. The bonus-end attack uses the same ability modifier as your main attack.
Choose one ability score and increase it by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency in saving throws using the chosen ability.

Prerequisite: Intelligence or Wisdom 13 or higher. Choose one spellcasting class and record two 1st-level ritual spells of your choice from its list in a ritual book you carry. You can cast those spells as rituals, and you may copy additional rituals of a level you could cast into the book when you find them in written form.

Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can reroll the weapon's damage dice and choose either total to apply. This represents striking with brutal force that lets a poor hit land harder on a second chance.

When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, its speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn. Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even when they take the Disengage action, and when a creature adjacent to you attacks an ally, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it.

Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover, and suffer no disadvantage from attacking at long range. Before attacking you can take a -5 penalty to the attack roll to add +10 to the damage if the attack hits.

While wielding a shield you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws against effects that target only you. You can use a bonus action to attempt to shove a creature after taking the Attack action, and if you succeed on a Dexterity save against an effect that would deal half damage on a success, you can use your reaction to take no damage by interposing your shield.
You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice. This training reflects broad practice that makes you competent in fields outside your class and background.

Prerequisite: Dexterity 13 or higher. You can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured from your target, and dim light does not impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight. When you miss with a ranged weapon attack while hidden, your position is not revealed.

Prerequisite: the ability to cast at least one spell. The range of your spells that require an attack roll is doubled, and your spell attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. You also learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll from a chosen spellcasting class list.

Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Your unarmed strikes and improvised weapon attacks use a d4 for damage, and when you hit a creature with one you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple it.
Your hit point maximum increases by 2 for each level you have, applied retroactively when you take this feat. Whenever you gain a level afterward, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2.

Prerequisite: the ability to cast at least one spell. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration, and you can perform somatic components even with weapons or a shield in hand. When a creature provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can cast a single-target cantrip at it instead of making a melee attack.
Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with any four weapons of your choice, reflecting dedicated training with arms outside your usual repertoire.
